Novartis non è in grado di offrire il supporto di trasferimento: si prega di applicare solo se accessibile. Novartis ha abbracciato una strategia coraggiosa per guidare una trasformazione digitale a livello aziendale. Il nostro obiettivo è quello di posizionare Novartis come leader del settore adottando proattivamente tecnologie digitali che favoriscono approcci innovativi per accelerare la scoperta e lo sviluppo della droga. Utilizzando dati R&D interni ed esterni con la potenza della scienza dei dati, modelli predittivi, AI generativo e machine learning, il nostro obiettivo è quello di identificare nuovi obiettivi, creare molecole terapeutiche più efficaci, prevedere meglio farmacocinetica e rischi di sicurezza, perfezionare il design di prova clinica e ridurre significativamente i cicli di sviluppo. Il team AI4R conduce BR nell'esplorazione e nell'applicazione di metodologie AI e ML avanzate per generare nuove intuizioni di scoperta della droga, e per accelerare e migliorare l'efficienza della scoperta della droga, concentrandosi sulle esigenze dei pazienti. I partner AI4R con i team di scoperta della droga, aumentano il livello di esperienza AI in Biomedical Research (BR) e assicurano che la scienza BR continui con l'ecosistema in rapida evoluzione delle tecnologie AI collegandosi con i leader dell'IA in accademia e industria. Questo ruolo di leadership per il gruppo AI Applicato di AI4R sarà affidato a una forte leadership tecnica, di squadra e di progetto, allineando con gli esperti di materia biomedica per comprendere profondamente le opportunità ML nella scoperta della droga, valutazione del paesaggio del modello, benchmarking del modello di leader, e applicando i giusti approcci AI, algoritmi, modelli e flussi di lavoro per massimizzare l'impatto sulle aree chiave di ricerca biomedica che potenzialmente porteranno a sviluppare farmaci migliori, più velocemente. Descrizione del lavoro Entra in un ruolo di leadership fondamentale all'avanguardia nell'innovazione scientifica, dove l'intelligenza artificiale all'avanguardia incontra la ricerca biomedica. In qualità di Direttore & Group Head (Applied AI), formerai come approcci avanzati di machine learning accelerano la scoperta dei farmaci, traducendo dati complessi in approfondimenti scientifici significativi che possono trasformare i risultati dei pazienti. Potrai condurre collaborazioni ad alto impatto, guidare la direzione strategica AI attraverso i domini di ricerca, e rafforzare i team di spingere i confini di ciò che è possibile nello sviluppo di farmaci migliori, più veloce. Principali responsabilità
• Definire e guidare la strategia di intelligenza artificiale applicata e roadmap pluriennale attraverso la ricerca di scoperta della droga.
• Allineare le priorità con le esigenze del portafoglio, le opportunità scientifiche e l'impatto commerciale e di ricerca misurabile.
• Leader team multidisciplinari per identificare, prototipo, benchmark e distribuire soluzioni di intelligenza artificiale fit-for-purpose.
• Governare un portafoglio di intelligenza artificiale applicato con l'assunzione chiara, la priorità, la risonanza, la supervisione della consegna e le metriche di successo.
• Stabilire le migliori pratiche per la definizione dei problemi, la disponibilità dei dati, il benchmarking, la progettazione della valutazione e lo sviluppo del modello riproducibile.
• Promuovere il benchmarking delle fondazioni e dei modelli specifici per le attività, consentendo scambi trasparenti e decisioni di adozione informate.
• Collaborare con i team di ingegneria per scalare le soluzioni e incorporarle nel processo decisionale scientifico quotidiano.
• Definire metriche di valutazione rigorose che collegano le prestazioni del modello a decisioni a valle e risultati sperimentali.
• Costruire una cultura del rigore scientifico, rapida iterazione, mentorship e impatto pratico tra le squadre.
• Forge collaborazioni accademiche e industriali strategiche per accelerare innovazione, benchmarking e trasferimento tecnologico. Requisiti essenziali
• Esperienza dimostrata nelle principali iniziative di sviluppo delle capacità di apprendimento delle macchine principali tra i team di scoperta della droga e casi di utilizzo.
• Esperienza dimostrata con il modello di base benchmarking nelle applicazioni di scoperta della droga.
• Esperienza pratica sull'applicazione dell'apprendimento automatico

Gehaltsbereich: CHF1,46,300.00 - CHF2,71,700.00 Stellenbeschreibung Zusammenfassung Berufsbezeichnung: Director & Group Head (Applied AI) #LI-Hybrid Standort: Basel, Schweiz Relocation Support: Diese Rolle hat ihren Sitz in Basel, Schweiz. Novartis kann keine Umzugsunterstützung anbieten: Bitte bewerben Sie sich nur, wenn Sie erreichbar sind. Novartis hat eine mutige Strategie verfolgt, um eine unternehmensweite digitale Transformation voranzutreiben. Unser Ziel ist es, Novartis als Branchenführer zu positionieren, indem wir proaktiv digitale Technologien einsetzen, die innovative Ansätze zur Beschleunigung der Wirkstoffforschung und -entwicklung fördern. Durch die Nutzung sowohl interner als auch externer F & E-Daten mit der Leistungsfähigkeit von Data Science, prädiktiven Modellen, generativer KI und maschinellem Lernen ist es unser Ziel, neue Ziele zu identifizieren, effektivere therapeutische Moleküle zu erstellen, Arzneimittelpharmakokinetik und Sicherheitsrisiken besser vorherzusagen, das Design klinischer Studien zu verfeinern und Entwicklungszyklen deutlich zu verkürzen. Das AI4R-Team leitet BR bei der Erforschung und Anwendung fortschrittlicher KI- und ML-Methoden, um neue Erkenntnisse in der Wirkstoffforschung zu generieren und die Effizienz der Wirkstoffforschung zu beschleunigen und zu verbessern, während es sich auf die Bedürfnisse der Patienten konzentriert. AI4R arbeitet mit Wirkstoffforschungsteams zusammen, erhöht das Niveau der KI-Expertise in der biomedizinischen Forschung (BR) und stellt sicher, dass die BR-Wissenschaft mit dem sich schnell entwickelnden Ökosystem der KI-Technologien Schritt hält, indem sie sich mit KI-Führungskräften in Wissenschaft und Industrie verbindet. Diese Führungsrolle für die Applied AI-Gruppe von AI4R wird mit einer starken technischen, Team- und Projektführung beauftragt, die sich mit biomedizinischen Fachexperten zusammensetzt, um die ML-Möglichkeiten in der Wirkstoffforschung, der Bewertung der Modelllandschaft, der Leitung des Modell-Benchmarkings und der Anwendung der richtigen KI-Ansätze, Algorithmen, Modelle und Workflows zu verstehen und die Auswirkungen auf wichtige Bereiche der biomedizinischen Forschung zu maximieren, die möglicherweise dazu führen werden Entwicklung besserer Medikamente, schneller. Stellenbeschreibung Treten Sie in eine zentrale Führungsrolle an der Spitze der wissenschaftlichen Innovation ein, wo innovative künstliche Intelligenz auf biomedizinische Forschung trifft. Als Director & Group Head (Applied AI) gestalten Sie, wie fortschrittliche maschinelle Lernansätze die Wirkstoffforschung beschleunigen und komplexe Daten in sinnvolle wissenschaftliche Erkenntnisse übersetzen, die die Patientenergebnisse verändern können. Sie werden einflussreiche Kooperationen leiten, die strategische KI-Richtung über Forschungsbereiche hinweg lenken und Teams befähigen, die Grenzen dessen, was bei der Entwicklung besserer Medikamente möglich ist, schneller zu überschreiten. Wichtigste Zuständigkeiten
• Definieren und leiten Sie die angewandte Strategie für künstliche Intelligenz und die mehrjährige Roadmap für die Wirkstoffforschung.
• Ausrichtung der Prioritäten auf Portfolioanforderungen, wissenschaftliche Möglichkeiten und messbare Auswirkungen auf Unternehmen und Forschung.
• Führen Sie multidisziplinäre Teams an, um Lösungen für künstliche Intelligenz zu identifizieren, zu entwickeln, zu vergleichen und einzusetzen.
• Leiten Sie ein Portfolio für angewandte künstliche Intelligenz mit klaren Annahme-, Priorisierungs-, Resourcing-, Lieferaufsichts- und Erfolgsmetriken.
• Etablieren Sie Best Practices für Problemrahmen, Datenbereitschaft, Benchmarking, Bewertungsdesign und reproduzierbare Modellentwicklung.
• Förderung des Benchmarkings von Stiftungs- und aufgabenspezifischen Modellen, um transparente Kompromisse und fundierte Adoptionsentscheidungen zu ermöglichen.
• Zusammenarbeit mit Ingenieurteams, um Lösungen zu skalieren und sie in die tägliche wissenschaftliche Entscheidungsfindung einzubetten.
• Definieren Sie strenge Bewertungsmetriken, die die Modellleistung mit nachgelagerten Entscheidungen und experimentellen Ergebnissen verbinden.
• Bauen Sie eine Kultur der wissenschaftlichen Strenge, schnellen Iteration, Mentoring und praktischen Auswirkungen in allen Teams auf.
• Schmieden Sie strategische akademische und industrielle Kooperationen, um Innovation, Benchmarking und Technologietransfer zu beschleunigen. Grundlegende Anforderungen
• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in führenden Kernentwicklungsinitiativen für maschinelles Lernen in Wirkstoffforschungsteams und Anwendungsfällen.
• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung mit Foundation Model Benchmarking in Wirkstoffforschungsanwendungen.
• Hands-on-Erfahrung mit maschinellem Lernen
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Échelle salariale : 1 46 300,00 CHF - 2 71 700,00 CHF Résumé de la description d'emploi Titre du poste: Directeur et chef de groupe (IA appliquée) #LI-Hybrid Lieu: Bâle, Suisse Soutien à la réinstallation: Ce rôle est basé à Bâle, en Suisse. Novartis n'est pas en mesure d'offrir une aide à la réinstallation : veuillez soumettre une demande seulement si elle est accessible. Novartis a adopté une stratégie audacieuse pour conduire une transformation numérique à l'échelle de l'entreprise. Notre objectif est de positionner Novartis comme un leader de l'industrie en adoptant proactivement des technologies numériques qui favorisent des approches novatrices pour accélérer la découverte et le développement de médicaments. En utilisant les données internes et externes de R-D avec la puissance de la science des données, des modèles prédictifs, de l'IA générative et de l'apprentissage machine, notre objectif est d'identifier de nouvelles cibles, de créer des molécules thérapeutiques plus efficaces, de mieux prédire la pharmacocinétique des médicaments et les risques pour la sécurité, d'affiner la conception des essais cliniques et de raccourcir considérablement les cycles de développement. L'équipe de l'IA4R dirige BR dans l'exploration et l'application de méthodologies avancées d'IA et de ML pour générer de nouvelles idées de découverte de médicaments, et pour accélérer et améliorer l'efficacité de la découverte de médicaments tout en se concentrant sur les besoins des patients. L'IA4R s'associe à des équipes de découverte de médicaments, augmente le niveau d'expertise de l'IA dans l'ensemble de la recherche biomédicale (BR) et veille à ce que la science de l'IA continue de s'adapter à l'écosystème en évolution rapide des technologies de l'IA en se connectant aux leaders de l'IA dans les milieux universitaires et industriels. Ce rôle de chef de file pour le groupe AI4R appliqué sera chargé d'assurer un solide leadership technique, d'équipe et de projet, en s' alignant avec les experts en matière biomédicale pour bien comprendre les possibilités de ML dans la découverte de médicaments, l'évaluation du paysage du modèle, l'analyse comparative des modèles et l'application des approches, algorithmes, modèles et flux de travail appropriés en matière d'IA afin de maximiser l'impact sur les domaines clés de la recherche biomédicale qui pourraient mener à la mise au point de meilleurs médicaments, plus rapidement. Description de l'emploi Entrez dans un rôle de leadership central à l'avant-garde de l'innovation scientifique, où l'intelligence artificielle de pointe rencontre la recherche biomédicale. En tant que directeur et chef de groupe (IA appliquée), vous déterminerez comment l'apprentissage automatique avancé s'approche pour accélérer la découverte de médicaments, transformant des données complexes en données scientifiques significatives qui peuvent transformer les résultats des patients. Vous dirigerez des collaborations à impact élevé, guiderez l'orientation stratégique de l'IA dans tous les domaines de recherche et permettreez aux équipes de repousser les limites de ce qui est possible pour développer de meilleurs médicaments, plus rapidement. Principales responsabilités
• Définir et diriger la stratégie d'intelligence artificielle appliquée et la feuille de route pluriannuelle pour la recherche sur la découverte de médicaments.
• Harmoniser les priorités avec les besoins du portefeuille, les possibilités scientifiques et l'impact mesurable des activités et de la recherche.
• Diriger des équipes multidisciplinaires pour identifier, prototyper, comparer et déployer des solutions d'intelligence artificielle adaptées à l'usage.
• Gouvernance d'un portefeuille de renseignements artificiels appliqués comportant des données d'entrée, de priorité, de ressourcement, de surveillance de l'exécution et de mesure du succès.
• Établir des pratiques exemplaires pour l'élaboration des problèmes, la préparation aux données, l'analyse comparative, la conception de l'évaluation et l'élaboration de modèles reproductibles.
• Diriger l'analyse comparative des modèles de base et des modèles spécifiques aux tâches, en permettant des compromis transparents et des décisions d'adoption éclairées.
• Partenaire avec des équipes d'ingénierie pour mettre à l'échelle les solutions et les intégrer dans la prise de décision scientifique quotidienne.
• Définir des mesures d'évaluation rigoureuses reliant le rendement du modèle aux décisions en aval et aux résultats expérimentaux.
• Construire une culture de rigueur scientifique, d'itération rapide, de mentorat et d'impact pratique entre les équipes.
• Forger des collaborations stratégiques entre les universités et l'industrie pour accélérer l'innovation, l'étalonnage et le transfert de technologie. Exigences essentielles
• Expérience démontrée dans la conduite d'initiatives de développement de la capacité d'apprentissage automatique au sein des équipes de découverte de médicaments et des cas d'utilisation.
• Expérience éprouvée de l'analyse comparative des modèles de base dans les applications de découverte de médicaments.
• Expérience pratique en appliquant l'apprentissage automatique

• Reinigung, Vorbereitung und Desinfektion von Produktionsanlagen und Räumlichkeiten

• Durchführung von Probenahmen, Aliquotierungen und In-Prozess-Kontrollen

• Überwachung der Anlagenfunktion und frühzeitiges Erkennen von Abweichungen

• Technisches Verständnis sowie Fähigkeit, selbstständig und zuverlässig nach Vorgaben zu arbeiten

• Erfahrung mit Prozessleitsystemen, idealerweise DeltaV (Emerson) oder Siemens Steuerungssysteme

• Sorgfältige, strukturierte und qualitätsbewusste Arbeitsweise mit hoher Eigenverantwortung

• Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse sowie grundlegende Englischkenntnisse

Wünschenswerte Anforderungen :

• Sicherer Umgang mit Microsoft Office und Prozessleitsystemen

• Erfahrung mit Prozessleitsystemen, idealerweise DeltaV (Emerson) oder Siemens Steuerungssysteme

• Sorgfältige, strukturierte und qualitätsbewusste Arbeitsweise mit hoher Eigenverantwortung

• Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse sowie grundlegende Englischkenntnisse

Wünschenswerte Anforderungen :

Benefits & Leistungen

Wenn Sie aufgrund einer Erkrankung oder Behinderung spezielle Unterstützung während des Rekrutierungsprozesses benötigen und/oder detailliertere Informationen über die wesentlichen Funktionen der Stelle wünschen, senden Sie bitte eine E-Mail an diversity.inclusion_ch@novartis.com und teilen Sie uns die Art Ihres Anliegens und Ihre Kontaktinformationen mit. Warum Novartis : Menschen mit Krankheiten und ihre Familien zu unterstützen, erfordert mehr als innovative Wissenschaft. Es braucht eine Gemeinschaft aus klugen, engagierten Menschen wie Ihnen. Menschen, die zusammenarbeiten, sich gegenseitig unterstützen und inspirieren. Gemeinsam erreichen wir Durchbrüche, die das Leben von Patienten verändern. jobs.description:
Salary Range:
CHF220,500.00 - CHF409,500.00

Job Description Summary
#LI-Hybrid
Location: Basel, Switzerland

What if the deals you shape today could define the future of healthcare? As Head BD&L Transactions, Immunology, you’ll be at the heart of Novartis’ growth engine—leading high-impact partnerships that bring transformative therapies to patients worldwide. From early research to commercialization, you’ll architect and negotiate complex, global deals, working at the intersection of science, strategy, and business. This is a rare opportunity to influence our immunology pipeline, collaborate with senior leaders, and position Novartis as a partner of choice across the industry.

Job Description
Key Responsibilities

• Architect and negotiate complex licensing and partnering transactions across all development stages

• Drive deal structuring, term sheet development, and contract negotiations with external partners

• Orchestrate cross-functional teams to build strong, data-driven business cases

• Partner closely with Therapeutic Area leadership to align on strategy and priorities

• Navigate governance processes, presenting clear recommendations to senior decision-makers

• Manage internal and external stakeholders to advance deals efficiently and competitively

• Monitor external landscape, identifying partnering opportunities and competitive activity

• Strengthen and leverage an extensive industry network to unlock high-value collaborations

• Champion Novartis as a partner of choice through impactful interactions and deal execution

Essential Requirements

• PhD in Science, ideally combined with a Master of Business Administration or equivalent

• Extensive experience in business development, licensing, or investment banking within the pharmaceutical industry

• Proven track record of sourcing, structuring, negotiating, and closing complex partnership deals

• Deep understanding of drug development across research, development, and commercialization stages

• Strong leadership experience managing global, cross-functional teams and strategic initiatives

• Excellent communication and influencing skills, with ability to engage senior executives and external partners

Please submit a deal sheet with clear description of the deal and explanation of contribution with your application.

Benefits & Rewards
At Novartis, we’re committed to reimagining medicine together - and rewarding the people who make it happen.

Expected Annual Base Salary Range for role: CHF 220.500 - 409.500

The base salary offered is determined based on gender-neutral objectives, such as relevant skills, competencies and experience in accordance with the Novartis pay setting policy and upon joining Novartis will be reviewed periodically.

The rewards of being part of our team go far beyond base pay and incentives. We also offer a variety of competitive benefits in kind to help you thrive personally and professionally, such as insurance plans, retirement plans, wellbeing resources and global recognition programs. In addition, we provide flexible and hybrid working options, where possible, and minimum 14 weeks paid parental leave.

In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible for a performance-based bonus depending on certain performance parameters. Long-term equity awards granted at group level may also be part of your package. Further details will be provided during the application process.

Read our brochure to learn more about our global total rewards offering:
https://www.novartis.com/sites/novartis_com/files/novartis-life-handbook.pdf

Note: Benefits and compensation may vary by country and are subject to local legal requirements, including provisions of collective bargaining agreements where applicable. A full overview of your compensation package, including any relevant collective bargaining agreement details applicable to your role based on your employment location and Novartis employer entity, will be communicated separately to you during

• Architetto e negozia complesse operazioni di licensing e partner in tutte le fasi di sviluppo
• Organizzare un accordo, sviluppare un foglio di termine e negoziare contratti con partner esterni
• Orchestrare i team interfunzionali per costruire casi aziendali forti e basati sui dati
• Collaborare a stretto contatto con la leadership di Therapeutic Area per allineare la strategia e le priorità
• Navigare processi di governance, presentando raccomandazioni chiare ai decisori senior
• Gestire gli stakeholder interni ed esterni per avanzare in modo efficiente e competitivo
• Monitorare il paesaggio esterno, identificare le opportunità di partner e l'attività competitiva
• Rafforzare e sfruttare una vasta rete industriale per sbloccare collaborazioni ad alto valore
• Campione Novartis come partner di scelta attraverso interazioni di impatto e l'esecuzione degli accordi Requisiti essenziali
• PhD in Scienza, idealmente combinato con un Master of Business Administration o equivalente
• Estensiva esperienza nello sviluppo aziendale, nel licensing o nel settore farmaceutico
• Provato record traccia di approvvigionamento, strutturazione, negoziazione e chiusura di contratti di partenariato complessi
• Profonda comprensione dello sviluppo della droga attraverso le fasi di ricerca, sviluppo e commercializzazione
• Forte esperienza di leadership gestendo team globali, interfunzionali e iniziative strategiche
• Ottima comunicazione e capacità di influenzare, con la capacità di coinvolgere dirigenti senior e partner esterni Si prega di presentare un foglio di contratto con chiara descrizione dell'accordo e la spiegazione del contributo con la vostra domanda. Vantaggi e premi A Novartis, ci impegniamo a riimmaginare insieme la medicina e a premiare le persone che lo fanno accadere. Campo d'insalatura annuale previsto per il ruolo: CHF 220.500 - 409.500 Lo stipendio base offerto è determinato sulla base di obiettivi di genere-neutral, come le competenze rilevanti, competenze e l'esperienza in conformità con la politica di impostazione della retribuzione Novartis e dopo l'adesione Novartis saranno esaminati periodicamente. Le ricompense di far parte del nostro team vanno ben oltre la retribuzione base e gli incentivi. Offriamo anche una varietà di vantaggi competitivi in genere per aiutare a prosperare personalmente e professionalmente, come piani di assicurazione, piani di pensionamento, risorse di benessere e programmi di riconoscimento globale. Inoltre, forniamo opzioni di lavoro flessibili e ibride, dove possibile, e minimo 14 settimane congedo parentale pagato. Oltre al tuo stipendio base, potresti essere idoneo per un bonus basato sulle prestazioni a seconda di determinati parametri di prestazione. I premi azionari a lungo termine concessi a livello di gruppo possono anche essere parte del vostro pacchetto. Ulteriori dettagli saranno forniti durante il processo di applicazione. Leggi la nostra brochure per saperne di più sulla nostra offerta globale di premi totali: https://www.novartis.com/sites/novartis com/files/novartis-life-handbook.pdf Nota: i benefici e i risarcimenti possono variare per paese e sono soggetti a requisiti legali locali, comprese le disposizioni di contratti collettivi, ove applicabile. Una panoramica completa del vostro pacchetto di compensazione, compresi i dettagli relativi del contratto collettivo applicabile al vostro ruolo in base alla vostra posizione di lavoro e l'entità del datore di lavoro Novartis, sarà comunicata separatamente a voi durante

As a Patent Attorney, you will play a pivotal role in protecting groundbreaking scientific discoveries and enabling life-changing medicines to reach patients worldwide. Partnering closely with R&D teams, you will drive strategic intellectual property decisions, build robust patent portfolios, and navigate complex legal landscapes to safeguard innovation across the product lifecycle.

Job Description

• Provide clear, strategic, and business-focused counsel to Novartis R&D clients on invention protection, portfolio development, publication strategy, and third-party risks.

• Build and manage patent portfolios for Novartis R&D projects by identifying inventions and preparing, prosecuting, maintaining, and defending patent filings across areas such as new molecular entities, processes, manufacturing, platforms, technologies, and clinical developments.

• Render legal opinions on patentability, validity, and freedom to operate, and develop patent strategies that strengthen IP positions, support freedom to operate, and enable effective IP defense.

• Apply deep knowledge of national patent law and practice, including relevant legal developments and patent trends, to shape strategy and advice.

• Understand and apply other forms of exclusivity protection, as appropriate.

• Communicate effectively with colleagues and leaders across the legal, IP, and R&D organizations.

• Build and manage relationships with outside counsel and collaborators, including extensive interaction within a multicultural global patent function.

• Conduct due diligence and provide counsel based on those assessments, including freedom-to-operate, infringement, validity, risk evaluation, and risk mitigation strategies.

• Provide IP support for transactional matters, including M&A, research collaborations, and in-licensing opportunities, with advice on contract drafting and negotiation

• Ensure high-quality, timely delivery of work aligned with business goals and budgets

Essential Requirements

• University degree in law, admission to the bar and qualification as a European Patent Attorney / Lawyer

• Advanced degree in chemistry or related field, with strong preference for a doctoral degree

• Significant experience as a patent attorney within a law firm or pharmaceutical or biotechnology environment

• Strong technical expertise in chemistry, preferably including experience with small molecules, synthesis, or pharmaceutical development.

• Expertise in U.S. and PCT patent law, filing processes, and prosecution practice, with a detailed understanding of European patent law and other major global patent systems

• Proven ability to partner with scientific and business stakeholders to deliver strategic intellectual property advice

• Strong analytical, communication, and decision-making skills with high attention to detail

• Ability to manage multiple priorities effectively within a fast-paced, global environment

At Novartis, we’re committed to reimagining medicine together - and rewarding the people who make it happen.

• Juris Dottore laurea con ammissione ad almeno una barra di stato, e registrazione alla pratica prima dell'Ufficio brevetti e marchi degli Stati Uniti.
• Grado avanzato in chimica o campo correlato, con forte preferenza per un grado di dottorato
• Esperienza significativa come avvocato brevetti all'interno di uno studio legale o farmaceutico o biotecnologia
• Forte competenza tecnica in chimica, preferibilmente compreso l'esperienza con piccole molecole, sintesi o sviluppo farmaceutico.

Als Patentanwalt spielen Sie eine zentrale Rolle beim Schutz bahnbrechender wissenschaftlicher Entdeckungen und ermöglichen es lebensverändernden Medikamenten, Patienten weltweit zu erreichen. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit F & E-Teams werden Sie strategische Entscheidungen über geistiges Eigentum vorantreiben, robuste Patentportfolios aufbauen und komplexe Rechtslandschaften navigieren, um Innovationen über den gesamten Produktlebenszyklus hinweg zu sichern. Stellenbeschreibung Wichtigste Zuständigkeiten
• Bereitstellung einer klaren, strategischen und geschäftsorientierten Beratung für Novartis F&E-Kunden zu Erfindungsschutz, Portfolioentwicklung, Publikationsstrategie und Risiken von Dritten.
• Aufbau und Verwaltung von Patentportfolios für Forschungs- und Entwicklungsprojekte von Novartis durch die Identifizierung von Erfindungen und die Vorbereitung, Verfolgung, Pflege und Verteidigung von Patentanmeldungen in Bereichen wie neuen molekularen Einheiten, Prozessen, Herstellung, Plattformen, Technologien und klinischen Entwicklungen.

• Kommunizieren Sie effektiv mit Kollegen und Führungskräften in den Rechts-, IP- und F & E-Organisationen.

• Bedeutende Erfahrung als Patentanwalt in einer Anwaltskanzlei oder im pharmazeutischen oder biotechnologischen Umfeld
• Starkes technisches Know-how in der Chemie, vorzugsweise einschließlich Erfahrung mit kleinen Molekülen, Synthese oder pharmazeutischer Entwicklung.

En tant qu'avocat en brevets, vous jouerez un rôle central dans la protection des découvertes scientifiques révolutionnaires et dans l'accès aux médicaments qui changent la vie des patients dans le monde entier. En étroite collaboration avec les équipes de R-D, vous dirigerez les décisions stratégiques en matière de propriété intellectuelle, créerez de solides portefeuilles de brevets et naviguerez dans des paysages juridiques complexes pour préserver l'innovation tout au long du cycle de vie des produits. Description de l'emploi Principales responsabilités
• Fournir des conseils clairs, stratégiques et axés sur les affaires aux clients de la R-D de Novartis sur la protection des inventions, l'élaboration de portefeuilles, la stratégie de publication et les risques pour les tiers.
• Créer et gérer des portefeuilles de brevets pour les projets de R-D de Novartis en identifiant les inventions et en préparant, poursuivant, maintenant et défendant les dépôts de brevets dans des domaines tels que les nouvelles entités moléculaires, les processus, la fabrication, les plates-formes, les technologies et les développements cliniques.
• Rendre des avis juridiques sur la brevetabilité, la validité et la liberté de fonctionner, et élaborer des stratégies de brevets qui renforcent les positions en matière de propriété intellectuelle, soutiennent la liberté de fonctionner et permettent une défense efficace de la propriété intellectuelle.
• Appliquer une connaissance approfondie du droit et de la pratique nationaux en matière de brevets, y compris les évolutions juridiques pertinentes et les tendances en matière de brevets, pour façonner la stratégie et les conseils.
• Comprendre et appliquer d'autres formes de protection de l'exclusivité, selon le cas.
• Communiquer efficacement avec les collègues et les dirigeants des organismes juridiques, de la PI et de la R-D.
• Établir et gérer des relations avec des conseillers et des collaborateurs de l'extérieur, y compris une interaction étendue au sein d'une fonction de brevet mondial multiculturelle.
• Effectuer une diligence raisonnable et fournir des conseils fondés sur ces évaluations, y compris la liberté de fonctionner, la violation, la validité, l'évaluation des risques et les stratégies d'atténuation des risques.
• Fournir un soutien en matière de propriété intellectuelle pour les questions transactionnelles, y compris les fusions-acquisitions, les collaborations en recherche et les possibilités de licence, en fournissant des conseils sur la rédaction et la négociation de contrats
• Veiller à ce que les travaux soient exécutés en temps opportun et de qualité, conformément aux objectifs opérationnels et aux budgets. Exigences essentielles
• Juris Doctor diplômé avec admission à au moins un barreau d'État, et l'enregistrement à pratiquer devant l'Office américain des brevets et des marques.
• Diplôme avancé en chimie ou domaine connexe, avec une forte préférence pour un doctorat
• Expérience importante en tant qu'avocat en brevets dans un cabinet d'avocats ou un environnement pharmaceutique ou biotechnologique
• Forte expertise technique en chimie, incluant de préférence l'expérience de petites molécules, synthèse ou développement pharmaceutique.
• Expertise en droit des brevets des États-Unis et du PCT, processus de dépôt et pratique des poursuites, avec une compréhension détaillée du droit européen des brevets et d'autres grands systèmes mondiaux de brevets
• Capacité éprouvée de s'associer avec des intervenants scientifiques et commerciaux pour fournir des conseils stratégiques en matière de propriété intellectuelle
• Fortes compétences en matière d'analyse, de communication et de prise de décisions avec une grande attention aux détails

This position can be based remotely anywhere in the U.S. Please note that this role would not provide relocation as a result. The expectation of working hours and travel (domestic and/or international) will be defined by the Hiring Manager.

Job Description
The Strategy, Platforms & Transformation t eam is dedicated to enabling improved decision-making at Novartis by leveraging data and advanced analytics capabilities to generate actionable insights that drive business growth. We work within the US business, bringing insights and challenging ideas to empower smarter, data-driven decision-making. This role is crucial in driving AI transformation by bringing the best in AI and tech to unlock opportunities for growth and improve patient outcomes.

The Executive Director, AI Foundations Engineering Lead will lead the engineering strategy, delivery, and operational excellence for the organization’s agentic AI operating system, with responsibility spanning solution architecture, development, operations, and continuous improvement. This role will be central to enabling the transformation of existing processes, products, and services into agentic AI products and intelligent workflows by providing a scalable, secure, and high performing foundation. The ideal candidate will bring deep engineering leadership, systems thinking, and technical vision to guide the design and evolution of core agentic capabilities, establish engineering standards and operating models, and lead cross functional teams in delivering resilient and extensible AI services. Working closely with product leaders, business stakeholders, data and technology teams, and transformation leaders, this role will ensure the agentic systems accelerate innovation, support enterprise adoption, and delivers measurable business value through reliable and scalable execution.

Major Accountabilities:

• Define and lead the engineering strategy, roadmap, and operating model for our organization’s agentic AI platform.

• Oversee the design, development, integration, deployment, and ongoing operation of foundational capabilities that support agentic AI products and workflows.

• Establish platform engineering standards, architectural principles, and development practices to ensure scalability, reliability, security, and maintainability.

• Lead cross functional engineering teams in building reusable platform services, tools, and components that accelerate product delivery and adoption.

• Partner with product, data, infrastructure, security, and business teams to align platform capabilities with enterprise priorities and evolving user needs.

• Drive platform performance, operational excellence, and continuous improvement through monitoring, feedback loops, incident review, and service optimization.

• Guide the modernization of existing systems and processes to enable integration with agentic AI products, workflows, and platform services.

• Communicate agentic AI strategy, technical direction, delivery progress, risks, and investment needs to senior executives and key stakeholders.

Essential Requirements:

• A minimum of a bachelor's degree in related field is required; Master of Science and/or MBA strongly preferred

• 15 plus years of progressive product management experience, including significant leadership over senior product leaders, with a strong track record of defining and scaling enterprise level product strategy and execution.

• Deep expertise in AI driven product management, including experience bringing innovative data, machine learning, and generative AI products from concept to commercialization in complex enterprise environments.

jobs.title: Analytical Project Lead (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Salary Range:
CHF126,000.00 - CHF234,000.00

Job Description Summary
#LI-Hybrid
Location: Basel, Switzerland
This role is based in Basel, Switzerland. Novartis is unable to offer relocation support for this role. Please only apply if this location is accessible for you.

We are a global team of highly skilled analytical project managers with presence in all biologics technical research and development sites of Novartis in Europe, and we are looking for you as an experienced, curious, inspiring Analytical Project Leader to join our team in Basel to support development of biologic products.

Job Description
Your Key Responsibilities:

• You are responsible for the overall analytical project strategy including robust and phase-dependent control strategy to support technical development of highly innovative biologic products.

• You will lead and coordinate the analytical sub-team in a matrix organization and represent the analytic discipline in the global CMC project team of assigned projects.

• You are accountable for managing all analytic related activities of drug product and drug substance development including release and stability testing, molecule characterization, method- development, -transfer and -validation, specification setting, know-how transfer etc.

• You will lead and coordinate timely delivery of high quality source documents for submission, review of regulatory documents and interact with Heath Authorities in audits and scientific advice meetings

• You will need to communicate effectively across organizational interfaces i.e. project-management, line functions, senior management, etc.

• You will proactively identify scientific, technological and GMP issues, propose creative solutions and communicate key issues to the appropriate management level

• You are responsible for high quality analytical registration documents for HA submissions and interact with authorities, act as technical expert in audits, inspections etc.

• You are responsible for analytical budget and resource planning

Minimum requirements :

• PhD and minimum of 8 years relevant experience of Biologics CMC development or University life-science degree with appropriate industry experience

• Excellent theoretical and profound scientific knowledge in analytical areas in biologic drug development

• Strong scientific leadership, bringing innovative molecules from research to development.

• Excellent understanding of regulatory expectations and requirements with significant experience with IND/ BLA submission

• Strong experience in leading matrix teams and strong communication skills

• Proficiency in English

Benefits & Rewards

At Novartis, we’re committed to reimagining medicine together - and rewarding the people who make it happen.

Expected Annual Base Salary Range for role: 126,000.00 - 234,000.00 CHF

The base salary offered is determined based on gender-neutral objectives, such as relevant skills, competencies and experience in accordance with the Novartis pay setting policy and upon joining Novartis will be reviewed periodically.

In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible for a performance-based bonus depending on certain performance parameters.

The rewards of being part of our team go far beyond base pay and incentives. We also offer a variety of competitive benefits in kind to help you thrive personally and professionally, such as insurance plans, retirement plans, wellbeing resources and global recognition programs. In addition, we provide flexible and hybrid working options, where possible, and minimum 14 weeks paid parental leave.

Read our brochure to learn more about our global total rewards offering:

https://www.novartis.com/sites/novartis_com/files/novartis-life-handbook.pdf

Note: Benefits and compensation may vary by country and are subject to local legal requirements, including provisions of collective bargaining agreements where applicable. A full overview of your compensation package, including any relevant

Gamma di insalata:
CHF126,000.00 - CHF234,000.00

Descrizione del lavoro
#LI-Hybrid #
Ubicazione: Basilea, Svizzera
Questo ruolo ha sede a Basilea, in Svizzera. Novartis non è in grado di offrire il supporto di trasferimento per questo ruolo. Si prega di applicare solo se questa posizione è accessibile per voi.

Siamo un team globale di direttori di progetti analitici altamente qualificati con presenza in tutti i siti di ricerca e sviluppo tecnico biologici di Novartis in Europa, e ti stiamo cercando come un esperto, curioso, ispiratore Leader di progetto analitico per unirsi al nostro team di Basilea per sostenere lo sviluppo di prodotti biologici.

Descrizione del lavoro
Le tue responsabilità chiave:

• Sei responsabile della strategia globale di progetto analitico, compresa la strategia di controllo robusta e dipendente dalla fase per supportare lo sviluppo tecnico di prodotti biologici altamente innovativi.

• Potrai guidare e coordinare il sub-team analitico in un'organizzazione di matrice e rappresentare la disciplina analitica nel team di progetto CMC globale di progetti assegnati.

• Siete responsabili per la gestione di tutte le attività correlate analitiche di sviluppo del prodotto della droga e della sostanza della droga, tra cui il rilascio e il test di stabilità, la caratterizzazione delle molecole, lo sviluppo dei metodi, -transfer e -validation, impostazione delle specifiche, trasferimento di know-how ecc.

• Potrai condurre e coordinare la consegna tempestiva di documenti di alta qualità fonte per la presentazione, la revisione dei documenti normativi e interagire con le autorità di Heath in audit e incontri di consulenza scientifica

• Sarà necessario comunicare efficacemente attraverso interfacce organizzative cioè project-management, funzioni di linea, senior management, ecc.

• Identificare proattivamente le questioni scientifiche, tecnologiche e GMP, proporre soluzioni creative e comunicare le questioni chiave al livello di gestione appropriato

• Sei responsabile di documenti di registrazione analitica di alta qualità per le presentazioni HA e interagire con le autorità, agire come esperto tecnico in audit, ispezioni ecc.

• Sei responsabile del bilancio analitico e della pianificazione delle risorse

Requisiti minimi:

• PhD e minimo 8 anni di esperienza rilevante di Biologics CMC sviluppo o laurea in scienze della vita universitaria con un'adeguata esperienza nel settore

• Eccellente conoscenza teorica e profonda scientifica nelle aree analitiche nello sviluppo di farmaci biologici

• Forte leadership scientifica, portando molecole innovative dalla ricerca allo sviluppo.

• Ottima comprensione delle aspettative e dei requisiti normativi con esperienza significativa con la presentazione IND/ BLA

• Esperienza forte nei principali team di matrice e forti capacità di comunicazione

• Proficienza in inglese

Vantaggi e premi

A Novartis, ci impegniamo a riimmaginare insieme la medicina e a premiare le persone che lo fanno accadere.

Campo d'insalatura annuale previsto per il ruolo: 126,000.00 - 234,000.00 CHF

Lo stipendio base offerto è determinato sulla base di obiettivi di genere-neutral, come competenze rilevanti, competenze ed esperienza in conformità con la politica di impostazione della retribuzione Novartis e dopo l'adesione Novartis saranno esaminati periodicamente.

Oltre al tuo stipendio base, potresti essere idoneo per un bonus basato sulle prestazioni a seconda di determinati parametri di prestazione.

Le ricompense di far parte del nostro team vanno ben oltre la retribuzione base e gli incentivi. Offriamo anche una varietà di vantaggi competitivi in genere per aiutare a prosperare personalmente e professionalmente, come piani di assicurazione, piani di pensionamento, risorse di benessere e programmi di riconoscimento globale. Inoltre, forniamo opzioni di lavoro flessibili e ibride, dove possibile, e minimo 14 settimane congedo parentale pagato.

Leggi la nostra brochure per saperne di più sulla nostra offerta globale di premi totali:

https://www.novartis.com/sites/novartis com/files/novartis-life-handbook.pdf

Nota: i benefici e i risarcimenti possono variare per paese e sono soggetti a requisiti legali locali, comprese le disposizioni di contratti collettivi, ove applicabile. Una panoramica completa del vostro pacchetto di compensazione, compreso qualsiasi

Job Description Summary
We are looking for an enthusiastic, curious, and highly motivated proteomics expert to join our Discovery Sciences Translational Profiling (TP) team in Basel. TP is a global group of experts in proteomics, metabolomics, lipidomics, super-resolution microscopy, and data science, within Novartis Biomedical Research at our sites in Basel, Switzerland and Cambridge, US.
As a Senior Principal Scientist, you will lead a proteomics lab team, play a pivotal role in advancing our cutting-edge technologies and contribute to our global proteomics strategy. This role involves collaboration with scientists, project teams, and five disease areas across Novartis Biomedical Research, all dedicated to creating and delivering transformative therapeutics to patients worldwide.

Job Description

Internal Job Title : Senior Principal Scientist
Position Location: Basel, CH onsite #LI-onsite

* This role is based in Basel, Switzerland. Novartis is unable to offer relocation support for this role: please only apply if this location is accessible for you.

Key Responsibilities:

• Initiate, lead, and oversee high-impact proteomics analyses across drug discovery programs, from early research to translational studies involving patient samples.

• Contribute to interdisciplinary research programs within a collaborative, matrixed environment, partnering across internal cross-functional teams and with external collaborators.

• Maintain a state-of-the-art proteomics platform by staying abreast of technological advancements and aligning capabilities with internal project needs and application priorities.

• Drive innovation in biomedical research by championing advanced technologies and cross-disciplinary initiatives, enabling novel applications of proteomics, such as low-input and spatial proteomics.

• Coach and mentor junior scientists, support project teams, and facilitate the work of direct/matrix reports and key collaborators.

Essential Requirements:

• PhD in biology, biochemistry, or a related discipline, with a minimum of five years of academic experience in proteomics applied to biomedical research, or comparable experience in the biotechnology/pharmaceutical industry.

• Extensive knowledge of and experience with proteomics approaches and technologies, with key applications in biomedical and translational research as demonstrated by a strong publication record and significant contributions to the proteomics field.

• Strong data science skills with a solid understanding of biostatistical principles.

• Proven ability to lead a cross-functional team in a matrix environment.

• Collaborative, innovative mindset with the ability to adapt quickly to a dynamic, fast-paced, multi-disciplinary research environment.

• Exceptional communication and presentation skills for multidisciplinary audiences across various seniority and expertise levels.

Desirable Requirements:

• Experience with pathway analysis and multi-omics data integration as well as knowledge of advanced data science approaches, including skills in Python and/or R.

• Expertise in spatial and low input proteomics.

• Ampia conoscenza e esperienza con approcci e tecnologie proteomiche, con applicazioni chiave nella ricerca biomedica e traduttiva come dimostrato da un forte record di pubblicazione e contributi significativi al campo proteomics.

• Competenza nella proteomica spaziale e a basso input.

A Novartis, ci impegniamo a riimmaginare insieme la medicina e a premiare le persone che lo fanno accadere.

• Maintenir une plate-forme protéomique à la fine pointe de la technologie en se tenant au courant des progrès technologiques et en alignant les capacités sur les besoins internes des projets et les priorités d'application.

• Favoriser l'innovation dans la recherche biomédicale en défendant les technologies de pointe et les initiatives interdisciplinaires, en permettant de nouvelles applications de la protéomique, comme la protéomique à faible rendement et la protéomique spatiale.

• Entraîner et mentorer des scientifiques subalternes, appuyer des équipes de projet et faciliter le travail des rapports directs et des collaborateurs clés.

Exigences essentielles :

• Doctorat en biologie, en biochimie ou dans une discipline connexe, avec au moins cinq années d'expérience universitaire en protéomique appliquée à la recherche biomédicale, ou expérience comparable dans l'industrie biotechnologique/pharmaceutique.

• Connaissance approfondie et expérience des approches et des technologies de la protéomique, avec des applications clés dans la recherche biomédicale et translationnelle, comme en témoigne un solide dossier de publication et des contributions importantes au domaine de la protéomique.

• Compétences solides en sciences des données avec une bonne compréhension des principes biostatistiques.

• Capacité éprouvée de diriger une équipe interfonctionnelle dans un environnement matriciel.

• Un état d'esprit collaboratif et innovant capable de s'adapter rapidement à un environnement de recherche multidisciplinaire dynamique et rapide.

• Compétences exceptionnelles en communication et en présentation pour les publics multidisciplinaires à divers niveaux d'ancienneté et d'expertise.

Exigences souhaitables:

• Expérience de l'analyse des parcours et de l'intégration des données multi-omiques ainsi que de la connaissance des approches avancées en sciences des données, y compris les compétences en Python et/ou en R.

• Expertise en protéomique spatiale et à faible entrée.

Avantages et récompenses :

À Novartis, nous sommes engagés à réinventer la médecine ensemble - et à récompenser les gens qui la font arriver.

jobs.description:
Salary Range:
CHF133,700.00 - CHF248,300.00

Job Description Summary
Location: Basel, Switzerland #hybrid

Role Purpose:
Provide specialist knowledge and guidance on sterile and low bioburden processes, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements. Implement, harmonize, and continuously improve aseptic standards and best practices across TRD pilot plants and all modalities (Cell and Gene Therapies, Radioligand Therapies, ADC, and New Biological Entities).

Act as a key partner in cross-functional projects, troubleshooting issues and aligning stakeholders on pragmatic solutions and standards. Mentor and develop members of the TRD QA Sterile Operations Network, addressing critical skills gaps.

Job Description
Major Accountabilities:

• Establish, lead, and continuously develop a TRD QA Sterile Operations Network, fostering accountability, learning, and collaboration.

• Provide specialist knowledge and guidance on sterile and low bioburden processes, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements.

• Implement, harmonize, and continuously improve aseptic standards and best practices across TRD pilot plants and across all modalities (Cell and Gene Therapies, Radioligand Therapies, ADC, and New Biological Entities).

• Drive continuous improvement, knowledge transfer, and innovation in sterility assurance.

• Act as a key partner in cross-functional projects, troubleshooting issues and aligning stakeholders on pragmatic solutions and standards.

• Mentor and develop members of the TRD QA Sterile Operations Network, addressing critical skills gaps.

• Consult on the evaluation and selection of external contractors for aseptic appropriateness, ensuring integrity of outsourced processes.

Desired skills:

• Influence without authority in a matrix environment—build credibility, align stakeholders, and drive standards adoption.

• Proactive relationship-building—actively engage cross-functional partners to create momentum for change.

• Pragmatic risk-taking—balance diligence with smart, solution-oriented decision-making.

• Advanced problem-solving—lead troubleshooting and resolution across departmental boundaries.

• Effective communication—tailor messaging, negotiate, and handle pushback diplomatically.

• Political savvy—navigate informal networks and overcome barriers to secure a seat at the table.

Qualifications

• Advanced degree (PhD, MSc, or equivalent) in life sciences, pharmacy, or related field

• Extensive experience in sterile manufacturing, quality assurance, or related areas within the pharmaceutical/biotech industry

• Strong knowledge of aseptic processing, sterility assurance, and regulatory requirements (e.g., FDA, EMA, ICH)

• Proven track record in leading cross-functional teams or networks, ideally in a matrix environment

• Demonstrated ability to influence without authority and drive change across organizational boundaries

• Excellent problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills

• Fluent in English; additional languages a plus

Benefits & Rewards

At Novartis, we’re committed to reimagining medicine together - and rewarding the people who make it happen.

Expected Annual Base Salary Range for role: €133,700 to €248,300

The base salary offered is determined based on gender-neutral objectives, such as relevant skills, competencies and experience in accordance with the Novartis pay setting policy and upon joining Novartis will be reviewed periodically.

In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible for a performance-based bonus depending on certain performance parameters.

The rewards of being part of our team go far beyond base pay and incentives. We also offer a variety of competitive benefits in kind to help you thrive personally and professionally, such as insurance plans, retirement plans, wellbeing resources and global recognition programs. In addition, we provide flexible and hybrid working options, where possible, and minimum 14 weeks paid parental leave.

Accessibili

Principali passività:

• Stabilire, guidare e sviluppare continuamente un TRD QA Sterile Operations Network, promuovere la responsabilità, l'apprendimento e la collaborazione.

• Fornire conoscenze e indicazioni specialistiche sui processi sterili e a basso bioburden, garantendo il rispetto dei requisiti normativi.

• Implementare, armonizzare e migliorare continuamente gli standard asettici e le migliori pratiche in impianti pilota TRD e in tutte le modalità (Cell and Gene Therapies, Radioligand Therapies, ADC e New Biological Entities).

• Agire come partner chiave in progetti multifunzionali, risolvere problemi e allineare gli stakeholder su soluzioni e standard pragmatici.

Competenze desiderate:

• L'influenza senza autorità in un ambiente matrice—costruire credibilità, allineare le parti interessate e guidare l'adozione degli standard.

• Proattiva relazione-costruzione—attivamente coinvolgere partner interfunzionali per creare slancio per il cambiamento.

• Presa di rischio Pragmatic—diligenza di equilibrio con il processo decisionale intelligente e orientato alla soluzione.

• Risolvere i problemi avanzati: eseguire la risoluzione dei problemi e la risoluzione attraverso i confini dipartimentali.

• Efficace comunicazione: la messaggistica, negoziare e gestire il pushback diplomaticamente.

• Savvy politico—individuare reti informali e superare le barriere per garantire un posto al tavolo.

Qualifiche

• Laurea avanzata (PhD, MSc, o equivalente) in scienze della vita, farmacia, o campo relativo

• Ampia esperienza nella produzione sterile, nella garanzia della qualità o nelle aree connesse all'industria farmaceutica/biotecnica

• Forte conoscenza di elaborazione asettica, garanzia di sterilità e requisiti normativi (ad esempio, FDA, EMA, ICH)

• Provato track record in team o reti interfunzionali leader, idealmente in un ambiente matrice

• Capacità dimostrata di influenzare senza autorità e di guidare il cambiamento attraverso i confini organizzativi

• Eccellente capacità di problem solving, comunicazione e gestione degli stakeholder

• Fluente in inglese; lingue aggiuntive a plus

Vantaggi e premi

A Novartis, ci impegniamo a riimmaginare insieme la medicina e a premiare le persone che lo fanno accadere.

Gamma di insalata annuale prevista per il ruolo: €133.700 a €248,300

Lo stipendio base offerto è determinato sulla base di obiettivi di genere-neutral, come le competenze rilevanti, competenze e l'esperienza in conformità con la politica di impostazione della retribuzione Novartis e dopo l'adesione Novartis saranno esaminati periodicamente.

Oltre al tuo stipendio base, potresti essere idoneo per un bonus basato sulle prestazioni a seconda di determinati parametri di prestazione.

Le ricompense di far parte del nostro team vanno ben oltre la retribuzione base e gli incentivi. Offriamo anche una varietà di vantaggi competitivi in genere per aiutare a prosperare personalmente e professionalmente, come piani di assicurazione, piani di pensionamento, risorse di benessere e programmi di riconoscimento globale. Inoltre, forniamo opzioni di lavoro flessibili e ibride, dove possibile, e minimo 14 settimane congedo parentale pagato.

Location: Basel, Switzerland

#LI-Hybrid 3 days/week in office

Internal job title: Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) Data42

About the Role:
The Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) at Data42 is an embedded technical delivery leader who partners directly with domain teams to turn high-value problems into working data and AI applications. You will rapidly prototype, iterate, and productionize solutions on Palantir Foundry, bridging users, product, and platform engineering to deliver measurable outcomes. This role blends software engineering, data engineering, and product-oriented problem solving, with a strong emphasis on user workflow adoption and operational durability.

Job Description
Key Responsibilities:

• Embedded delivery and problem solving: Embed with domain teams to understand workflows, define success criteria, and translate needs into shipped capabilities; Lead discovery, solution framing, and iterative delivery from prototype to production.

• Build on Palantir Foundry : Design and implement end-to-end solutions in Foundry , including data pipelines, transformations, ontology alignment, and application workflows; Configure and optimize Foundry-based applications to support operational decision-making and repeatable analytics; Apply Foundry-native patterns for permissions, auditability, performance, and release management.

• Data engineering and modeling : Ingest, transform, and model diverse datasets to make them usable and trustworthy for analytics and applications; Define data quality checks and ensure datasets are fit for intended use (document assumptions and limitations).

• Application development and integration : Build user-facing applications or workflow experiences and integrate with upstream and downstream systems as needed; Support deployment, monitoring, and ongoing improvement of production applications.

• Cross-functional leadership : Partner closely with product managers, data scientists, data engineers, governance, and platform teams to align scope, timelines, and standards; Communicate trade-offs clearly and unblock delivery through technical and stakeholder influence.

• Enablement and reuse : Create reusable templates, components, and patterns to accelerate future deliveries across Data42; Mentor teammates and contribute to internal documentation, playbooks, and delivery standards.

Essential Requirements:

• Bachelors degree in Biology, Bioengineering, Bioinformatics, Biostatistics or related discipline.

• 8+ years of experience working in biomedical research, bioengineering, bioinformatics or related domain.

• Hands-on experience with Palantir Foundry building and operationalizing solutions (pipelines, ontology, applications, and access controls), with a Foundry-first engineering and delivery mindset.

• Solid experience in partnering with stakeholders to understand challenges and define effective solutions, developing and delivering Proof of Concepts to validate ideas and demonstrate business value.

• Demonstrated experience delivering software, data, or analytics products in a fast-paced, user-facing environment, with expertise in rapid prototyping to production execution.

• Strong programming skills and comfort working across data and application layers.

• Strong user empathy and workflow orientation, with proven ability to work directly with end users, clarify ambiguous requirements, and deliver iteratively.

• Excellent communication skills and stakeholder management skills, with strong reliability and operational discipline.

Desirable requirements:

• Experience delivering solutions in regulated or sensitive-data environments, with strong attention to access control and audit needs.

• Familiarity with product discovery methods (problem framing, value definition, iterative MVP delivery).

• Experience with analytics, AI, or machine learning enablement within production applications.

Ubicazione: Basilea, Svizzera

#LI-Hybrid 3 giorni / settimana in ufficio

Titolo del lavoro interno: Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) Data42

Informazioni sul ruolo:
Il Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) di Data42 è un leader tecnico integrato che collabora direttamente con i team di dominio per trasformare problemi di alto valore in dati di lavoro e applicazioni AI. Verrai rapidamente prototipo, iterare e produrre soluzioni su Palantir Foundry, bridging utenti, product, and platform engineering per fornire risultati misurabili. Questo ruolo fonde l'ingegneria del software, l'ingegneria dei dati e la risoluzione dei problemi orientata al prodotto, con una forte enfasi sull'adozione del flusso di lavoro degli utenti e sulla durata operativa.

Descrizione del lavoro
Responsabilità chiave:

• Consegna incorporata e problem solving: incorporare con i team di dominio per comprendere i flussi di lavoro, definire i criteri di successo e tradurre le esigenze in capacità spedite; Guida scoperta, soluzione di inquadratura e consegna iterativa dal prototipo alla produzione.

• Costruisci su Palantir Foundry: Progettare e implementare soluzioni end-to-end in Foundry , inclusi datadotti, trasformazioni, allineamento ontologia e flussi di lavoro applicativi; Configurare e ottimizzare le applicazioni basate sulla Fonderia per supportare il processo decisionale operativo e l'analisi ripetibile; Applicare modelli basati sulla Fonderia per autorizzazioni, verificabilità, performance e gestione del rilascio.

• Ingegneria dei dati e modellazione: Ingest, trasforma e modella diversi dataset per renderli utilizzabili e affidabili per analisi e applicazioni; Definire i controlli di qualità dei dati e garantire che i set di dati siano adatti all'uso previsto (supposti di documenti e limitazioni).

• Sviluppo dell'applicazione e integrazione: costruire applicazioni orientate all'utente o esperienze di flusso di lavoro e integrare con sistemi a monte e a valle, se necessario; supportare l'implementazione, il monitoraggio e il miglioramento continuo delle applicazioni di produzione.

• Leadership trasversale: collaborare a stretto contatto con i responsabili dei prodotti, gli scienziati dei dati, gli ingegneri dei dati, i team di governance e piattaforma per allineare la portata, le linee temporali e gli standard; Comunicare i trade-offs chiaramente e sbloccare la consegna attraverso l'influenza tecnica e degli stakeholder.

• Attivazione e riutilizzo: Crea modelli, componenti e modelli riutilizzabili per accelerare le consegne future su Data42; compagni di squadra Mentor e contribuire alla documentazione interna, playbook e standard di consegna.

Requisiti essenziali:

• Laurea in Biologia, Bioingegneria, Bioinformatica, Biostatistica o disciplina relativa.

• 8+ anni di esperienza nel campo della ricerca biomedica, della bioingegneria, della bioinformatica o del relativo dominio.

• Esperienza a mano con Palantir Foundry building e soluzioni operative (pipeline, ontologia, applicazioni e controlli di accesso), con una mentalità ingegneristica e di consegna.

• Esperienza solida nel collaborare con gli stakeholder per comprendere le sfide e definire soluzioni efficaci, sviluppare e fornire Proof of Concepts per convalidare idee e dimostrare valore aziendale.

• Esperienza dimostrata che offre software, dati o prodotti di analisi in un ambiente veloce e facile da usare, con esperienza nella prototipazione rapida all'esecuzione di produzione.

• Forte capacità di programmazione e comfort di lavoro attraverso i dati e gli strati di applicazione.

• Forte empatia dell'utente e orientamento del flusso di lavoro, con comprovata capacità di lavorare direttamente con gli utenti finali, chiarire i requisiti ambigui e fornire iterativamente.

• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione e capacità di gestione degli stakeholder, con forte affidabilità e disciplina operativa.

Requisiti desiderabili:

• Esperienza nella fornitura di soluzioni in ambienti regolamentati o sensibili, con una forte attenzione alle esigenze di controllo degli accessi e audit.

• Familiarità con metodi di scoperta dei prodotti (inquadratura dei problemi, definizione del valore, consegna iterativa MVP).

• Esperienza con funzionalità di analisi, AI o machine learning all'interno delle applicazioni di produzione.

• Data Engineering und Modellierung: verschiedene Datensätze aufnehmen, transformieren und modellieren, um sie für Analysen und Anwendungen nutzbar und vertrauenswürdig zu machen; Definieren Sie Datenqualitätsprüfungen und stellen Sie sicher, dass Datensätze für den beabsichtigten Gebrauch geeignet sind (Annahmen und Einschränkungen von Dokumenten).

• Anwendungsentwicklung und -integration: Erstellen von benutzerorientierten Anwendungen oder Workflow-Erfahrungen und bei Bedarf Integration in vor- und nachgelagerte Systeme; Unterstützung der Bereitstellung, Überwachung und laufenden Verbesserung von Produktionsanwendungen.

• Cross-Functional Leadership: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Produktmanagern, Datenwissenschaftlern, Dateningenieuren, Governance- und Plattformteams, um Umfang, Zeitpläne und Standards abzustimmen; Kommunizieren Sie Kompromisse klar und entsperren Sie die Lieferung durch technischen Einfluss und Stakeholder.

• Aktivierung und Wiederverwendung: Erstellen Sie wiederverwendbare Vorlagen, Komponenten und Muster, um zukünftige Lieferungen in Data42 zu beschleunigen; Mentor-Teamkollegen und tragen zu internen Dokumentationen, Playbooks und Lieferstandards bei.

• Praktische Erfahrung mit dem Aufbau und der Operationalisierung von Palantir Foundry-Lösungen (Pipelines, Ontologie, Anwendungen und Zugangskontrollen) mit einer Foundry-First-Engineering- und Delivery-Mentalität.

• Demonstrierte Erfahrung bei der Bereitstellung von Software, Daten oder Analyseprodukten in einer schnelllebigen, benutzerorientierten Umgebung mit Fachwissen im Bereich Rapid Prototyping bis hin zur Produktionsausführung.

• Starke Programmierkenntnisse und Komfort arbeiten über Daten- und Anwendungsschichten hinweg.

• Starke Benutzerempathie und Workflow-Orientierung mit nachgewiesener Fähigkeit, direkt mit Endbenutzern zu arbeiten, mehrdeutige Anforderungen zu klären und iterativ zu liefern.

• Hervorragende Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und Fähigkeiten im Stakeholder-Management mit starker Zuverlässigkeit und operativer Disziplin.

As Senior Legal Counsel TA Oncology, International, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the future of cancer care. Working at the heart of the Breast Cancer Therapeutic Area, you will partner with senior leaders to enable bold innovation, guide high-impact strategic decisions, and help bring transformative medicines to patients worldwide. Job Description Summary
Location: Basel, Switzerland
This role is based in Basel, Switzerland. Novartis is unable to offer relocation support for this role. Please only apply if this location is accessible for you.

We are looking for an associate to join the Analytical Characterization (AC) team in Basel, Switzerland. AC supports Novartis’ new biological entities (NBEs) development from proof-of-concept in human (i.e., finalization of the first phase I clinical trial) to commercialization and life-cycle management activities. AC applies a wide range of analytical techniques to characterize biopharmaceutical products. The AC team belongs to the Analytical Development unit, which is part of Novartis Technical Research and Development (TRD).

As part of the surface plasmon resonance (SPR) laboratory team within AC, the successful applicant will provide analytical support for NBE development by using state-of-the-art biophysical techniques to elucidate binding affinity and kinetics of the active pharmaceutical ingredient to its biological target and to immune receptors. The applicant will work in a highly collaborative and scientific environment, in close interaction with other experts in the analytical community.

Job Description
Accountabilities include

We are seeking an accomplished and visionary scientific leader to join us as TA Head, PK Sciences (PKS) Immunology. In this highly visible role, you will lead a cross-functional scientific organization spanning pharmacokinetics, clinical pharmacology, bioanalysis, and quantitative pharmacology across discovery, early development, and late-stage development. • Build trust through transparent communication, clear accountability, and consistent delivery against commitments

• Empower others to innovate and improve while maintaining high scientific, ethical, and operational standards

Job Description Summary
#LI-Hybrid

Location: Basel, Switzerland or London, UK (see separate posting)

As Senior Legal Counsel, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the future of Neuroscience and advancing breakthrough gene therapies. Working at the heart of the International Neuroscience & Gene Therapies Therapeutic Area, you will partner with senior leaders to enable bold innovation, guide high-impact strategic decisions, and help bring transformative medicines to patients worldwide. This is a unique opportunity to combine legal excellence with business leadership, enabling and influencing complex and innovative global initiatives across commercial, medical affairs, development, and market access functions while helping redefine what is possible for patients living with neurological and rare diseases.

Job Description
Key Responsibilities

• Serve as a lead legal partner for a portfolio of innovative products and strategic initiatives within the International Neuroscience & Gene Therapies Therapeutic Ar ea.

• Provide strategic legal guidance to commercial, medical, value and access, and development teams and other key stakeholders.

• Identify, assess, and mitigate legal, regulatory, and compliance risks across key business activities.

• Lead drafting, negotiation, and management of complex research, development, and commercial agreements.

• Support business development activities, alliance management, and integration of strategic assets and partnerships.

• Enable compliant promotional, medical, congress, investor relations, corporate and other external communication and conte nt.

• Drive innovation by enabling novel business approaches and supporting successful product launch strategies.

• Build organizational capability through legal training, cross-functional collaboration, and knowledge sharing.

• Close partnership and collaboration with global, region and country legal colleagues to ensure coordinated and consistent legal support across the product portfolio.

Essential Requirements

• Law degree and bar admission with strong legal expertise in a commercial environment.

• Significant post-qualification legal experience, gained either within the healthcare or pharmaceutical sector, or with a top-tier law firm advising healthcare and technology clients.

• Strong understanding of pharmaceutical legal frameworks, compliance requirements, and risk management principles.

• Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders and provide pragmatic and proactive advice in complex global organizations.

• Excellent negotiation, communication, and relationship-building skills across diverse cross-functional teams.

• Track record of effectively managing competing priorities and delivering high-quality outcomes under tight deadlines.

• Fluency in English, with the ability to navigate ambiguity and drive solutions independently.

Desirable Requirements

• In-house legal experience within a global pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or healthcare organization.

• Experience in the rare disease sector, including its associated legal, regulatory, commercial and access landscape

Benefits & Rewards
At Novartis, we’re committed to reimagining medicine together - and rewarding the people who make it happen.

In addition, we provide flexible and hybrid working options, where possible, and minimum 14 weeks paid parental

Descrizione del lavoro
Principali responsabilità

• Servire come partner legale leader per un portafoglio di prodotti innovativi e iniziative strategiche all'interno della International Neuroscience & Gene Therapeutic Ar ea.

• Fornire indicazioni legali strategiche per i team commerciali, medici, di valore e di accesso e di sviluppo e altri stakeholder chiave.

• Identificare, valutare e mitigare i rischi legali, normativi e di conformità attraverso le attività aziendali chiave.

• Progettazione, negoziazione e gestione di complessi accordi di ricerca, sviluppo e commerciali.

• Sostenere le attività di sviluppo aziendale, la gestione delle alleanze e l'integrazione dei beni strategici e delle partnership.

• Abilitare la pubblicità conforme, medico, congresso, relazioni degli investitori, corporate e altre comunicazioni esterne e conte nt.

• Guida l'innovazione consentendo nuovi approcci aziendali e supportando strategie di lancio di prodotti di successo.

• Costruire la capacità organizzativa attraverso la formazione legale, la collaborazione interfunzionale e la condivisione delle conoscenze.

• Una stretta collaborazione e collaborazione con colleghi legali globali, regionali e nazionali per garantire un supporto giuridico coordinato e coerente in tutto il portafoglio prodotti.

Requisiti essenziali

• Laurea legale e ammissione al bar con una forte competenza legale in un ambiente commerciale.

• Significativa esperienza legale post-qualificazione, acquisita sia all'interno del settore sanitario o farmaceutico, o con uno studio legale superiore che consiglia clienti sanitari e tecnologici.

• Forte comprensione delle strutture legali farmaceutiche, dei requisiti di conformità e dei principi di gestione del rischio.

• Prove capacità di influenzare gli stakeholder senior e fornire consulenza pragmatica e proattiva in organizzazioni globali complesse.

• Ottima la negoziazione, la comunicazione e le capacità di costruzione di relazioni tra diverse squadre interfunzionali.

• Tracciare il record di gestire efficacemente le priorità concorrenti e fornire risultati di alta qualità sotto scadenze strette.

• Fluency in inglese, con la capacità di navigare in ambiguità e guidare soluzioni indipendentemente.

Requisiti desiderabili

• Esperienza giuridica interna all'interno di un'organizzazione globale farmaceutica, biotecnologia o sanità.

• Esperienza a supporto delle operazioni aziendali internazionali.

Vantaggi e premi
A Novartis, ci impegniamo a riimmaginare insieme la medicina e a premiare le persone che lo fanno accadere.

Campo d'insalatura annuale previsto per il ruolo: CHF 146.300 - 271.700

Lo stipendio base offerto è determinato sulla base di obiettivi di genere-neutral, come le competenze rilevanti, competenze e l'esperienza in conformità con la politica di impostazione della retribuzione Novartis e dopo l'adesione Novartis saranno esaminati periodicamente.

Le ricompense di far parte del nostro team vanno ben oltre la retribuzione base e gli incentivi. Offriamo anche una varietà di vantaggi competitivi in genere per aiutare a prosperare personalmente e professionalmente, come piani di assicurazione, piani di pensionamento, risorse di benessere e programmi di riconoscimento globale. Job Description Summary
#LI-Hybrid
Internal Title: Senior Associate, Clinical Data Strategy
Location: Basel, Switzerland

Responsible for implementing high-quality, data strategy planning within clinical programs, supporting downstream clinical assessment identification and selection, data collection consistency and facilitating robust, rapid decision-making across the Translational Medicine portfolio. The role supports the development and execution of indication, program and trial Data Strategy Plans, ensuring alignment of data collection with scientific and operational objectives and enabling effective handoff to clinical trial teams for execution

Job Description
Key Responsibilities:

• Execute/support end-to-end data strategy activities at the trial and program level, including a) development of Data Strategy Plans to support early data planning and risk assessment, and b) downstream data oversight through subject matter guidance around data visualization and exploration to ensure high-quality outputs that support clinical trial teams and enable data-driven decision-making.

• Contribute to early data strategy landscaping at the indication and focus area level by utilizing internal and external data sources (e.g., internal data repositories, articles/RWE data) to identify trends, insights, and opportunities for supporting trial design and translating these into fit-for-purpose data collection and oversight approaches at the study level.

• Advise on the selection, implementation, risk assessment and oversight of appropriate clinical assessments to support assigned clinical trials, particularly in the Neuroscience Therapeutic Area, with an understanding of population challenges, patient/caregiver/assessor needs and preferences and the criticality of consistency in collection and analysis.

Essential Requirements:

• Multi-year experience in the pharmaceutical, CRO, hospital or healthcare setting, ideally with a strong foundation in clinical trial planning/strategy and data collection/oversight

• Robust knowledge and management of COAs/PROs and specific assessments used in Neuroscience trials and patient populations (ideally with additional knowledge in other therapeutic areas)

• Knowledge of drug development processes and regulations

• Ability to prioritize effectively and work adaptably in a fast-paced environment, and to be comfortable with ambiguity, changing needs and with global, multi-disciplinary teams

• Excellent communication and collaboration.

Il ruolo supporta lo sviluppo e l'esecuzione di piani di strategia dati di indicazione, programma e sperimentazione, garantendo l'allineamento della raccolta dati con obiettivi scientifici e operativi e consentendo un efficace passaggio ai team di sperimentazione clinica per l'esecuzione

Descrizione del lavoro
